h1: Blockchain Product Authentication, Verified in Under 2 Seconds
bodyHtml:
AuthiChain combines AI image analysis with blockchain provenance to verify product authenticity in under two seconds. Every verification passes a 5-agent AI consensus before its result is anchored to Bitcoin L1, so the record cannot be altered after the fact.

Why AuthiChain

  • 5-agent AI security council screens every scan for anomalies before anchoring
  • W3C Verifiable Credentials — the manufacturer holds the keys, not us
  • Bitcoin L1 finality for tamper-proof provenance
  • EU DPP compliant for cross-border trade

Built for every vertical

Luxury, pharmaceutical (DSCSA), electronics, agriculture, art, and cannabis brands use AuthiChain to prove authenticity to regulators and customers alike. Plans start at $49/mo.

h1: Anti-Counterfeit QR Verification That Customers Can Trust
bodyHtml:

How it works

  • Scan the product QR — no app required
  • AI analyzes the image and cross-references the signed on-chain record
  • Get a 0–100 authenticity score in under two seconds

Brands in luxury, pharma, and electronics use AuthiChain to give customers a one-scan proof of authenticity and a tamper-evident provenance trail. From $49/mo.

title: Blockchain Government Document Verification | GovChain
metaDescription: Bitcoin-anchored verification for permits, certificates, and RFP awards. QR-checked in 2 seconds, works offline, no central authority. SBIR/SVIP eligible.
h1: Verify Government Documents in 2 Seconds, Offline
bodyHtml:
GovChain replaces paper-stamp verification with a Bitcoin-anchored hash for any government document — a permit, certificate, or RFP award. The document itself never changes; its provenance becomes immutable.

How verification works

  • Scan the document QR — no login, no database call, no phone call to the agency
  • Hash validation confirms authenticity in about two seconds
  • Works offline — no central authority required

GovChain is SBIR/SVIP eligible and built for the propose → pilot → statewide-contract path.
